decision.message: The SHT31 family (esp32_sht31_v1) does not support the low_current profile or 10k pull-ups; these options exist only for the BMP280 family. Please revise your profile or sensor selection.

clauses.text: Create an SHT31 temperature/humidity board using the 10k low_current profile with 100 pF total capacitance.
